caption: Quiet workout for apartment nights: five silent strength moves for the hours when someone is asleep next door. No jumping, no impact, no equipment, nothing through the floor. Save it for tonight.

voiceover.text: A child asleep on the other side of this wall.
You can still train. Every move here is silent. No jumping, no impact, nothing through the floor.
Glute bridges. Ten reps. Slow up, pause, slow down.
Wall sit. Thirty seconds. Back against the wall, hold.
Wall push-ups. Ten reps. Press away, return with control.
Lying heel taps. Ten reps. Core braced, breath steady.
Knee plank. Twenty five seconds. Still, quiet, strong.
Two rounds and you are done, and nobody stirred. What time does your home go quiet? Comment it.
